name: zrndr_flush_overwrite_queue
description: zRndr::FlushOverwriteQueue drains overwrite queued polygons, installs span-occlusion builders for the draw path, restores saved render state, and clears the queue count.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the replay loop keeps ESI at each record's savedInvDepthScale field, so HLIL renders many queued-record fields as negative offsets from a float* interior cursor even though the global queue record type and stride are reconstructed.
VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr queued-polygon rendering pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49a490 validates queued overwrite iteration, span-builder setup, saved inverse-depth and scan-convert state restore, and final queue-count reset.
The native smoke verifies queue drain, builder callback installation, and restored inverse-depth bias, inverse-depth scale, and scan-convert mode.
